dedupe_keys.name: nsgi gnss reference station data of the netherlands rinex and real time streams

description: The Netherlands Space and Geodetic Infrastructure (NSGI) makes raw GNSS data available from the Dutch GNSS reference stations. Its GNSS data pages offer station information with the metadata of each reference station, real-time NTRIP streams for real-time applications, and RINEX data for post-processing, while NETPOS, the Netherlands Positioning Service network RTK service, is for internal use by Kadaster and Rijkswaterstaat only. The same site covers the Dutch coordinate systems and transformations (RDNAPTRANS and others), the geoid and gravity, an online transformation tool and API, reference points such as core network points and NAP benchmarks, and the certification of GNSS reference stations, with a tariffs page. Access to the RINEX data and streams is online; no licence is stated on the page read, and the site has a tariffs page, so some services may be charged. Caveats: the network RTK service is not public, and the page read does not give the number of stations. Coverage is the Netherlands. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, land subsidence and dike monitoring, and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ReNEP of Portugal and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
